children.name: Central management explanation
children.content: This catalog, account or installation setting belongs to the central Gameplane installation. Server actions use each server’s location.

VbHwU.content: Pre-packaged game-server templates pulled from your configured module sources.

children.content: Vanilla / Paper / Spigot / Bukkit / Purpur / Forge / NeoForge / Fabric / Quilt servers with a version+loader picker and in-app Modrinth browse.

L5szt.content: Valheim dedicated server (lloesche/valheim-server) with a stable/public-test channel picker, a BepInEx mod volume, and in-app Thunderstore browse. Crossplay-friendly.

TkG6j.content: Factorio headless server (factoriotools/factorio) with a stable/latest/pinned channel picker, server-settings managed from the wizard, and a mods volume with in-app Factorio mod portal browse.

L5szt.content: Palworld dedicated server (thijsvanloef/palworld-server-docker) with RCON console, save-aware graceful stop, and a .pak mod volume with archive install.
Terraria + tModLoader dedicated server (passivelemon/terraria-docker) with a vanilla/tModLoader version picker and a tModLoader ModPacks volume. Console via container stdin.

children.content: Competitive shooter with MatchZy and CounterStrikeSharp plugin support. Game-server login token supplied as a secret.
Hardcore multiplayer survival with Oxide and Carbon mod loaders. Monthly forced wipe; schedule a backup before each one.

TkG6j.content: Zombie survival crafting in a destructible voxel world. Blood-moon horde nights are CPU-spiky — give it headroom.

L5szt.content: Satisfactory dedicated server (wolveix/satisfactory-server) with a stable/experimental branch picker. Env-configured; installs via steamcmd on first boot.
